title: ID0440568-DC/Si-D/PT-[MP / S0 170003502]  Cable replacement
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Through measurements with a precision multimeter and analysis
via the internal diagnostic system, it was identified that the internal resistance of the cable presented values above the operational limits recommended by the manufacturer.
